title: Vehicle routing: XL-n1048-k237 (CVRPLIB, 1,047 customers)
statement: Serve the 1,047 customers of XL-n1048-k237, a instance of CVRPLIB's XL set, released for the CVRPLIB Best Known Solution Challenge, from its depot with vehicles of capacity 128: each customer on exactly one route, the demand on each route at most 128, any number of routes. The cost is the total length of the routes, depot to depot, each distance the Euclidean distance rounded to the nearest integer (EUC_2D). The best known cost on CVRPLIB is 380,090 (our solution); it is not proven optimal. A solution of smaller cost improves it.
submission: Text file in CVRPLIB's solution format: one line per route, "Route #k: c1 c2 ...", customers numbered 1 to 1047 (node c + 1 of the instance file, whose depot is node 1). A "Cost" line, if present, is compared with the computed cost; the computed cost is the score.

best_known.source: CVRPLIB (galgos.inf.puc-rio.br/cvrplib), instance XL-n1048-k237 (id 280): best known cost 380,090, our solution, listed since 2026-10-28 (before it 380,092), not proven optimal; read 6 Nov 2026 13:22 UTC
